status_meanings.discovered: Category or proposed need identified; no working independent capability established.
status_meanings.understood: Scoped contract/algorithm supported by body or specification evidence, implementation not established.
status_meanings.implemented: Named independent subset exists in source; does not imply qualification.
status_meanings.tested: Named subset has documented software/reference tests; does not imply whole-category coverage.
status_meanings.hardware-validated: Exact stated native hardware/configuration workflow passed recorded physical acceptance; not currently claimed by any row.

scope: Native app feature roadmap. Status applies only to status_scope, never whole vendor category. Historical Python hardware comparison remains separate from native lifecycle qualification.

capabilities.capability: Filters, FFT and band power · Analyze
capabilities.status_scope: Python and native numerical feature tests; no physiological interpretation or native hardware qualification
capabilities.body_evidence: Symbol/class evidence only; routine bodies not established for this category.
capabilities.missing_parameters_assets_dependencies: Native feature port, prospective artifact-threshold validation, end-to-end timing and physical signal interpretation. Independent numeric settings are explicit; vendor spectral settings remain unresolved.
capabilities.current_implementation: processing/features.py defines 256-sample Hann/Welch spectra and 70 log-band-power features with explicit unvalidated amplitude/flat/rail rejection. Known-sine energy and unchanged-input tests exist; historical descriptive analysis remains separate. Native EEGSpectrum and EEGMentalFeatures share one spectral implementation; real-recording and synthetic oracles cover PSD and all 70 features. EEGIntervalAnalysis computes selected-window means and spectrograms with explicit structural rejection and artifact flags.
capabilities.target_component: Analysis service with versioned filter/window/PSD recipes and explicit display-only versus causal processing.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Fixed signal reference tests, frequency/amplitude response, unit consistency, gaps/short-window rejection and online latency.
capabilities.delivery_notes: Implemented/tested offline Python spectral subset; not a native or physiological-equivalence claim.

capabilities.capability: Mental command training, PCA and Gaussian classification · Calibrate
capabilities.status_scope: Independent Python and native Swift training/inference/evaluation with synthetic and reference-vector tests; no physiologically validated participant model or actionable output
capabilities.body_evidence: Selected bounded body evidence now exists: docs/MENTAL_REFERENCE_TRACE.md and evidence/mental-command-reference/manifest.json establish named feature-selection/PCA/canonical/Gaussian-density/posterior call sites and neutral-training state. Complete raw-to-feature path, numeric settings and vendor-trained state remain unresolved.
capabilities.missing_parameters_assets_dependencies: Prospective independently acquired task/neutral sessions, behavioral/artifact controls, ordinary-activity exposure, cross-session performance and native cue/label workflow qualification. External native file picker remains unresolved. Vendor weights/settings are neither required nor imported.
capabilities.current_implementation: Python processing/mental.py and the native EEGCore implement train-only scaling/feature ranking, PCA, diagonal Gaussian classification including neutral, score/distance rejection and persistence. Native profile creation and integrity-checked local storage, finalized-recording dataset loading, held-out labeled evaluation, exposure/cue metrics and provenance receipts now exist. EEGEvaluate uses the same native receipt/evaluation entry point as the app. Output remains experimental and system control disabled. This is an independent design, not a recovered vendor algorithm.
capabilities.target_component: One mental-processing service and versioned profile contract, consumed by the native Calibration workspace. Offline Python processing.workflow is the first research implementation, not a second user-facing application.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Synthetic numerical/state/profile tests plus real prospective whole-session evaluation with independently verified task labels, no content reuse, artifact controls, neutral exposure and uncertainty. Native port must match fixed reference vectors before physical integration; outputs stay disabled.
capabilities.delivery_notes: Saved-profile inspection and controls-only scope were exercised in the native app using a temporary synthetic fixture. Full native cue/training/evaluation UI and prospective physiology remain unqualified. Recent CI compiler failure is being repaired; local passing tests alone do not prove CI compatibility.
